description: Source code for the Journal Entry doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, validation, and utility functions for handling journal entries, inter-company transactions, and related accounting operations.

classes.name: StockAccountInvalidTransaction
classes.description: Custom validation error for invalid stock transactions.

classes.name: JournalEntry
classes.description: Main class representing a Journal Entry, with methods for validation, posting, canceling, and related accounting operations.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns the voucher type for feed display.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving or submitting the journal entry.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Actions to perform when the journal entry is submitted, such as creating GL entries and updating related documents.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Actions to perform when the journal entry is canceled, including unlinking references and reversing entries.

methods.name: get_title
methods.description: Returns the title of the journal entry.

methods.name: update_advance_paid
methods.description: Updates total advance paid amounts for related documents.

methods.name: update_status_for_full_and_final_statement
methods.description: Updates the status of related Full and Final Statement documents.

methods.name: validate_inter_company_accounts
methods.description: Validates inter-company journal entries for currency consistency.

methods.name: validate_stock_accounts
methods.description: Ensures stock accounts are only updated via stock transactions.

methods.name: apply_tax_withholding
methods.description: Applies tax deduction at source (TDS) if applicable.

methods.name: update_inter_company_jv
methods.description: Updates linked inter-company journal entries.

methods.name: update_invoice_discounting
methods.description: Validates and updates invoice discounting statuses.

methods.name: unlink_advance_entry_reference
methods.description: Removes references to advance entries.

methods.name: unlink_asset_reference
methods.description: Removes asset references linked to the journal entry.

methods.name: unlink_inter_company_jv
methods.description: Removes inter-company journal entry references.

methods.name: unlink_asset_adjustment_entry
methods.description: Removes asset adjustment references.

methods.name: validate_party
methods.description: Validates that parties are specified for receivable/payable accounts.

methods.name: check_credit_limit
methods.description: Checks credit limits for customers.

methods.name: validate_cheque_info
methods.description: Validates cheque number and date for bank entries.

methods.name: validate_entries_for_advance
methods.description: Validates that advance entries are correctly marked.

methods.name: validate_against_jv
methods.description: Validates against journal entries for asset/liability accounts.

methods.name: validate_reference_doc
methods.description: Validates linked reference documents like invoices and orders.

methods.name: validate_orders
methods.description: Validates order statuses and totals.

methods.name: validate_invoices
methods.description: Validates invoice statuses and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: set_against_account
methods.description: Sets against account fields based on debits and credits.

methods.name: validate_debit_credit_amount
methods.description: Ensures that debit and credit are not both zero.

methods.name: validate_total_debit_and_credit
methods.description: Checks that total debits equal total credits.

methods.name: set_total_debit_credit
methods.description: Calculates total debit, credit, and difference.

methods.name: validate_multi_currency
methods.description: Validates multi-currency accounts and sets exchange rates.

methods.name: set_amounts_in_company_currency
methods.description: Converts account amounts to company currency.

methods.name: set_exchange_rate
methods.description: Sets exchange rates for accounts based on currency and date.

methods.name: create_remarks
methods.description: Generates remarks for the journal entry based on references and remarks.

methods.name: set_print_format_fields
methods.description: Prepares fields for printing, such as total amount and payee details.

methods.name: set_total_amount
methods.description: Sets total amount and converts to words.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates General Ledger entries for the journal entry.

methods.name: get_balance
methods.description: Calculates and validates total debit and credit, adjusting for differences.

methods.name: get_outstanding_invoices
methods.description: Fetches outstanding invoices for write-off.

methods.name: get_values
methods.description: Retrieves invoice data for write-off.

methods.name: update_expense_claim
methods.description: Updates expense claim reimbursements.

methods.name: validate_expense_claim
methods.description: Validates expense claim amounts.

methods.name: validate_credit_debit_note
methods.description: Validates stock entry and related stock journal entries.

methods.name: validate_empty_accounts_table
methods.description: Ensures accounts table is not empty.

methods.name: set_account_and_party_balance
methods.description: Fetches and sets account and party balances.
